events.summary:
At 412 PM EDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm near
McIntosh, moving east at 20 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 50 mph and penny size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor damage to outdoor objects is
possible.

Locations impacted include...
Hinesville, Richmond Hill, Fort Stewart, McIntosh, Midway,
Flemington, Belfast, Keller, Sunbury and Burroughs.

This includes I-95 in Georgia between mile markers 76 and 98.

SVRRAH

The National Weather Service in Raleigh has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Central Wayne County in central North Carolina...
Southwestern Wilson County in central North Carolina...
Johnston County in central North Carolina...

* Until 500 PM EDT.

* At 411 PM EDT, a severe thunderstorm was located over Smithfield,
moving east at 20 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Goldsboro, Smithfield, Wilson, Benson, Fremont, Micro, Selma, Four
Oaks, Pine Level, and Kenly.

This includes the following highways...
Interstate 95 between Mile Markers 119 and 81.
Interstate 40 between Mile Markers 326 and 328.
NC Highway 264 between Mile Markers 38 and 47.

events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.region: DeSoto, MS; Marshall, MS; Fayette, TN; Shelby, TN
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...Urban and small stream flooding caused by excessive
rainfall continues.

* WHERE...Portions of North Mississippi, including the following
counties, DeSoto and Marshall and West Tennessee, including the
following counties, Fayette and Shelby.

* WHEN...Until 400 PM CDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 309 PM CDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. This will cause urban and small stream
flooding. Between 1 and 1.5 inches of rain have fallen.
- Additional rainfall amounts of 0.5 to 1 inch are expected
over the area. This additional rain will result in minor
flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Bartlett, Southaven, Collierville, Germantown, Olive Branch,
Cordova, Memphis, Lakeland, Arlington, Southeast Memphis,
Eads, Midtown Memphis, Piperton, Rossville, White Station,
Handy Corner, Parkway Village, Capleville, Fairhaven and
Lenow.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

which could capsize or damage small and large vessels.

for more.
